Orbit Meet live captions are now general.headline: Orbit Meet live captions are generally available
Orbit Meet live captions are now general.summary: Captions in 12 languages are included in Business Standard and Business Plus, and admins turn them on per organizational unit.
Orbit Meet live captions are now general.whyItMatters: An easy accessibility win to switch on for clients who run meetings with customers.

Orbit Mail will stop accepting basic aut.headline: Orbit Mail blocks password-only IMAP and POP from January 15, 2027
Orbit Mail will stop accepting basic aut.summary: Mail clients must switch to OAuth. Old scanners and line-of-business apps that send mail with basic authentication will stop working.
Orbit Mail will stop accepting basic aut.whyItMatters: Run the Legacy sign-ins report for each client now and plan replacements before the cutoff.

Orbit Drive Business price change.headline: Orbit Drive Business goes from $12.00 to $14.00 per user per month
Orbit Drive Business price change.summary: The new monthly price starts February 1, 2027; annual commitments renew at the new price after that date.
Orbit Drive Business price change.whyItMatters: Update client quotes and renewal notices.

KSA-2026-014: Keystone Agent 6.2.1 fixes.headline: Update Keystone Agent for Windows to 6.2.1
KSA-2026-014: Keystone Agent 6.2.1 fixes.summary: Versions before 6.2.1 let a signed-in user gain SYSTEM rights through the update service (CVSS 8.8). Keystone reports limited exploitation and no workaround.
KSA-2026-014: Keystone Agent 6.2.1 fixes.whyItMatters: The agent is on every managed Windows device, so push the update through your RMM this week.

Shared drive connectors for Lumen Assist.headline: Lumen Assistant can search Orbit Drive shared drives
Shared drive connectors for Lumen Assist.summary: The connector is in public preview for Team and Enterprise workspaces and follows each user's existing file permissions.
Shared drive connectors for Lumen Assist.whyItMatters: Worth testing on an internal tenant before anyone pitches it.

Higher usage limits on the Lumen Team pl.headline: Lumen Team plan limits rise to 500 messages a day
Higher usage limits on the Lumen Team pl.summary: Team members get 500 messages per day, resetting every 5 hours.
Higher usage limits on the Lumen Team pl.whyItMatters: Fewer limit complaints from heavy users.

Admin audit log export for Lumen Enterpr.headline: Lumen Enterprise audit logs can be exported or sent to a SIEM
Admin audit log export for Lumen Enterpr.summary: Admins can export 180 days of audit logs as CSV or stream them to a SIEM over HTTPS; it is generally available now.
Admin audit log export for Lumen Enterpr.whyItMatters: Clients with compliance requirements can now keep AI usage records with the rest of their logs.

Proposed rule: cyber incident reporting.headline: Proposed 72-hour incident reporting rule for small federal contractors
Proposed rule: cyber incident reporting.summary: Contractors with fewer than 100 employees would report covered cyber incidents within 72 hours. Comments close December 22, 2026.
Proposed rule: cyber incident reporting.whyItMatters: Clients with federal contracts may need an incident response plan that meets the deadline.

Report: Relay Remote flaw exploited agai.headline: Forum reports of a Relay Remote Server flaw being exploited
Report: Relay Remote flaw exploited agai.summary: Community posts say attackers are reaching help desk machines through Relay Remote Server. The vendor has not commented.
Report: Relay Remote flaw exploited agai.whyItMatters: Watch for a vendor advisory; the KEV section above already lists a Relay Remote Server entry.
